newsitem.title: USA: V-ONE sees narrowed Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: V-ONE sees narrowed Q1 loss.

text.p: V-ONE Corp said on Monday it expects to post a first quarter net loss of $0.04 a share after taxes compared with a net loss of $0.10 a share last year.
Before taxes, V-ONE said it expects a 1997 first quarter net loss of about $0.07 a share on revenue of about $2.4 million compared with $1 million in the same period last year.
V-ONE said the results are "fundamentally in line with expectations, but are preliminary and unaudited." Final results will be announced on April 29, 1997.
V-ONE develops and licenses SmartGate technology, aimed at allowing secure electronic transactions over public networks, such as the Internet.
